summary.headline: AI-capex-fear selloff resumed hard on the 7/7 session: Samsung's Q2 profit beat (surpassing NVDA and Apple) still missed sky-high AI-demand expectations, triggering a broad chip/AI-infrastructure re-rating on capex-durability doubts. MRVL -7.42%, CRDO -7.14%, LRCX -6.78% and AMD -6.57% all escalate/re-escalate to RED — a direct, tier-1-confirmed materialization of each name's already-flagged 'AI capex moderation / multiple compression' key_risk (CRDO and AMD had just resolved to green on 7/6 analyst upgrades — a sharp one-day whipsaw). AEM remains the lone persisting RED (Barnat guidance-cut risk still unresolved; formal update due 7/29). HUT (-6.83%) and MARA (-6.73%) fell in sympathy with the AI-infrastructure trade despite Bitcoin itself holding steady (~$61.8k-63.7k) — a sentiment-correlation move, not a fresh BTC-price-exposure confirmation, so held at AMBER rather than RED. TSM (-4.22%), KEYS (-3.44%), HOOD (-3.98%), COIN (-3.24%), CAT (-3.04%, tariff overhang), and SUPV (-3.6%, no name-specific catalyst found) round out a wide AMBER band on a broadly risk-off tape (QQQ -1.83% vs SPY -0.47%). Notable divergence: NVDA (+0.71%) decoupled entirely from the memory/equipment-led selloff. CWAN roster issue persists a 9th consecutive run.
summary.prior_session_note: Data reflects the 2026-07-07 (Tuesday) session, read pre-market on 2026-07-08.

flags.headline: MRVL -7.42% — re-escalated AMBER→RED: Samsung's AI-demand miss triggers broad memory/custom-silicon selloff
flags.detail: Fell to $232.12 as part of a broad chip-sector selloff triggered by Samsung's Q2 2026 results: record profit (surpassing NVIDIA and Apple) but AI-demand commentary that fell short of Wall Street's lofty bar, reviving 'capex discipline' concerns among hyperscalers per Morgan Stanley. Marvell has no earnings or company-specific news today (next report 2026-08-27); the move is macro/sector sympathy, but it directly engages the already-flagged valuation/capex-moderation key_risk at a name still trading at rich multiples off a ~150% run.
flags.thesis_link: Matches MRVL key_risk: "any miss against the $16.5B FY2028 revenue target or moderation in hyperscaler AI capex would trigger severe multiple compression" — today's sector-wide re-rating on capex-durability doubts is that risk actively repricing, even absent a Marvell-specific catalyst.

flags.headline: CRDO -7.14% — whipsaw: fully reverses the 7/6 analyst-upgrade rally and re-enters RED
flags.detail: Dropped to $246.39, giving back all of Monday's +9.71% upgrade-driven rally (Evercore/Stifel/BofA) and more, swept up in the same Samsung-earnings-triggered AI-capex-durability selloff hitting the whole chip complex. No CRDO-specific negative news found today. At 109x trailing / 39x forward P/E, this name has essentially zero margin of safety for sector sentiment swings — a one-day round-trip from RESOLVED to RED.
flags.thesis_link: Matches CRDO key_risk: "Extreme valuation ... embed aggressive growth expectations, leaving minimal margin of safety for any execution miss or AI capex slowdown."

flags.thesis_link: Matches LRCX key_risk: "any deceleration in AI infrastructure spending or fab construction delays could trigger significant multiple compression" at a 36.55x forward P/E.

'Advancing AI 2026' event (7/23) is the next name-specific catalyst.
flags.thesis_link: Matches AMD key_risk: "Forward P/E of 59.8x and 270% 52-week appreciation leave zero margin of safety — any AI spending deceleration or customer pause would trigger severe multiple compression."

flags.headline: AEM -3.03% — persisting RED: Barnat guidance-cut risk still unresolved, formal update due 7/29
flags.detail: No new operational or geotechnical disclosure since 7/1: the Barnat open pit's north-wall rock-mass movement remains under precautionary suspension, with H2 2026 production expected down ~60,000-80,000 oz and 2027-2028 potentially reduced up to ~150,000 oz/year pending an ongoing geotechnical assessment. Formal updated guidance is confirmed for release after market close 2026-07-29. Today's -3.03% move tracks the broader risk-off tape, not a new AEM-specific data point; analysts remain split (Jefferies Buy $200 PT vs UBS Neutral $170 PT, both from 7/6).
flags.thesis_link: Matches AEM key_risk: "any execution miss on the 4M+ oz production target ... could trigger meaningful valuation compression" — a confirmed multi-year production cut at a flagship asset is that execution-miss risk materializing.
